task: What is the boiling point of water at the summit of Mont Blanc, according to Alpine Facts?

pages.title: Alpine Facts: cooking at altitude
pages.snippet: Water boils at about 85 °C on the summit of Mont Blanc.
pages.html:
Alpine Facts: cooking at altitude

Air pressure falls with altitude, and so does the boiling point. At the summit of Mont Blanc (4,806 m) water boils at about 85 °C.
